tools.description: Find cheapest models by combined listed input plus output token price.

tools.name: pricing_history

tools.name: benchmark_lookup
tools.description: Find sourced benchmark rows by model, provider, or benchmark ID.

tools.name: latest_changes
tools.description: Return recent model launches, removals, and pricing changes.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search AI Pricing Hub news items.

tools.name: recommend_model
tools.description: Recommend models for a workload using price, context, and benchmark evidence.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "calculate_cost" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Estimate cost from model pricing and token volumes." → after: "Estimate cost from total input tokens, their cached subset, output tokens and request count. Optional batch_mode uses available batch rates with standard-rate fallback."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
